questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Two point charges +8q and -2q are located at x = 0 and x = L respectively. The point on the x-axis at which the net electric field is zero is:
questions.explanation: By Coulomb Law, k(8q)/x^2 = k(2q)/(x-L)^2 => 2/x = 1/(x-L) => x = 2L.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.source: Illustrative practice set (not an official paper)
questions.question: Which of the following has the highest first ionisation enthalpy?
questions.explanation: Ionisation enthalpy increases across a period; silicon (group 14) is highest among these period-3 elements.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.source: Illustrative practice set (not an official paper)
questions.question: The number of real solutions of the equation |x − 2| + |x + 1| = 3 is:
questions.explanation: For −1 ≤ x ≤ 2 the sum is exactly 3, so every x in that closed interval is a solution — infinitely many.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.source: Illustrative practice set (not an official paper)
questions.question: A particle is projected at 45° with speed u. The ratio of its maximum height to its horizontal range is:
questions.explanation: H = u²sin²θ/2g = u²/4g and R = u²sin2θ/g = u²/g, so H : R = 1 : 4.

questions.source: Illustrative practice set (not an official paper)
questions.question: The site of the light reaction of photosynthesis in a chloroplast is the:
questions.explanation: Light reactions occur on the thylakoid membranes where chlorophyll and the electron transport chain are located.

questions.source: Illustrative practice set (not an official paper)
questions.question: Which blood cells are chiefly responsible for the clotting of blood?
questions.explanation: Platelets (thrombocytes) release thromboplastin and aggregate to form the platelet plug.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.source: Illustrative practice set (not an official paper)
questions.question: The SI unit of electric flux is:
questions.explanation: Electric flux Φ = E·A, so its unit is (N/C)·m² = N·m²/C, equivalently V·m.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.source: Illustrative practice set (not an official paper)
questions.question: A convex lens of focal length 20 cm forms a real image twice the size of the object. The object distance is:
questions.explanation: m = −2 = v/u → v = −2u with sign convention; using 1/f = 1/v − 1/u gives u = −30 cm, i.e. 30 cm.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.source: Illustrative practice set (not an official paper)
questions.question: Which of the following is a colligative property?
questions.explanation: Colligative properties depend only on the number of solute particles; elevation of boiling point is one of them.
